security_and_integrity_rules: Use only the tenant-registered service and its KMS key reference; never accept a caller-selected KMS locator or private material.
Reject managed and read-only services before any provider rotation; the shared managed KMS key is not tenant-rotatable through this route.
Rotate inside KMS; never export or hold a private key.
Report provider rotation and publication failures without exposing provider credentials or raw upstream errors.
Do not claim a completed rotation in stored state when the provider did not rotate a key.

Only one rotation may hold a tenant lease through registry reload, provider rotation, and whole-registry save. Deny another in-flight rotation for that tenant before calling the provider; release by lease owner on every exit, with bounded expiry if the request is cancelled.
A rotated key invalidates a stale certificate; public publication must revalidate the certificate against the current KMS public key.
reviewed_divergence: The Python handler recorded last_rotated_at and appended previous_versions even when the provider returned ok=false. Rust must fail closed and avoid claiming rotation on provider failure, while retaining the released response field names for completed rotations. Rust also rejects a future activate_at because Transit rotates immediately; the Python path accepted a future annotation without scheduling activation.
